Version guard for stage checkpoint reuse

Source: R/checkpoint-guard.R
dot-pipeline_fingerprint.Rd

run_pipeline(use_checkpoints = TRUE) resumes a build from existing stage checkpoints (e.g. after an OOM/crash) instead of recomputing from scratch. That is only safe when the checkpoints were produced by the same pipeline build and params: otherwise a code fix (reinstall) or a param change would silently reuse a stale/buggy intermediate. These helpers fingerprint the current build+params and gate reuse on a match.

Usage

.pipeline_fingerprint(params = NULL)

.checkpoints_valid(work_dir, fp)

.stamp_fingerprint(work_dir, fp)

Arguments

params

Optional list of stage params to fold into the fingerprint.

work_dir

Stage work directory holding the .pipeline_fingerprint stamp.

fp

Current fingerprint from .pipeline_fingerprint().

Value

A single character string identifying the build + params.

.checkpoints_valid: TRUE iff work_dir was stamped with fp.

.stamp_fingerprint: invisibly NULL; writes the stamp file.

Details

The fingerprint is intentionally coarse: any mismatch (a reinstall flips the Built stamp; a param edit flips the params component) forces a clean recompute, which is always correct. Over-invalidation only costs time.
